# IndiqAI

IndiqAI is a relationship and customer-data platform for local businesses. Digital loyalty is the entry point: each establishment can create a program under its own brand, set its own rewards, invite customers, and encourage repeat visits.

## For visitors
- Audience: owners and managers of local businesses with recurring customers.
- Customers participate in the loyalty program of the business they visit.
- Each business has its own rules and rewards; points do not transfer between businesses.
- The page's product card is an illustrative example, not a live customer account or performance result.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://indiqai.com/): overview of IndiqAI's digital loyalty experience for local businesses.
